1.
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3.  The present application under Section 439 read with Section 482 of the CrPC seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 592/2023, under Sections 376/506/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Anand Vihar.
4.
Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
Let the factum of datesheet also be verified before the next date of hearing.
6. Issue notice to complainant, to be served through the SHO concerned for the next date of hearing.
